notes.text: Check that the form integration validates each Turnstile token on the server with Siteverify before accepting a submission. Displaying the widget alone does not protect the form. Tokens expire after five minutes and can be used only once, so forms left open or submitted again need a fresh token.

Pre-clearance is an optional feature for Cloudflare-protected domains. It issues a clearance cookie and requires the correct registered zone, widget hostnames and security challenges. Check whether you enabled this option before describing a Turnstile setup as cookie-free.
